# sh-action-island

**Purpose:** The action area of a card or screen: an optional note (sh-action-note) above core buttons. Type = which buttons, Style = Normal (in a card) or Floating (sticky with its own surface).

Profile card (migration, not yet core) · 16 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=2594-16928) (node `2594:16928`)

*Generated by `tools/components.py` from Figma. Values are token names; never copy numbers.*

## Types

### Type=Message + primary, Style=Normal

**Purpose:** A short message with the main action (Connect). Normal: sits inside a card or sheet.

### Type=Message + primary, Style=Floating

**Purpose:** A short message with the main action (Connect). Floating: own surface and shadow, sticky over content.

### Type=Message + premium, Style=Normal

**Purpose:** A short message with the premium action (Upgrade to Connect) for free members. Normal: sits inside a card or sheet.

### Type=Message + premium, Style=Floating

**Purpose:** A short message with the premium action (Upgrade to Connect) for free members. Floating: own surface and shadow, sticky over content.

### Type=Message + tertiary, Style=Normal

**Purpose:** A status message with a quiet undo action (Unhide, Unblock). Normal: sits inside a card or sheet.

### Type=Message + tertiary, Style=Floating

**Purpose:** A status message with a quiet undo action (Unhide, Unblock). Floating: own surface and shadow, sticky over content.

### Type=Message only, Style=Normal

**Purpose:** A status message with no action (report under review). Normal: sits inside a card or sheet.

### Type=Message only, Style=Floating

**Purpose:** A status message with no action (report under review). Floating: own surface and shadow, sticky over content.

### Type=Primary only, Style=Normal

**Purpose:** One main action, centred, max width 200 (See similar profiles). Normal: sits inside a card or sheet.

### Type=Primary only, Style=Floating

**Purpose:** One main action, centred, max width 200 (See similar profiles). Floating: own surface and shadow, sticky over content.

### Type=Secondary + primary, Style=Normal

**Purpose:** A second action beside the main one (Super Connect, View Contact, Shaadi Chat, Call Consultant). Normal: sits inside a card or sheet.

### Type=Secondary + primary, Style=Floating

**Purpose:** A second action beside the main one (Super Connect, View Contact, Shaadi Chat, Call Consultant). Floating: own surface and shadow, sticky over content.

### Type=Tertiary + primary, Style=Normal

**Purpose:** Decline and accept a request. Normal: sits inside a card or sheet.

### Type=Tertiary + primary, Style=Floating

**Purpose:** Decline and accept a request. Floating: own surface and shadow, sticky over content.

### Type=Three actions, Style=Normal

**Purpose:** Three labelled icon actions (Shaadi Chat, WhatsApp, Call). Normal: sits inside a card or sheet.

### Type=Three actions, Style=Floating

**Purpose:** Three labelled icon actions (Shaadi Chat, WhatsApp, Call). Floating: own surface and shadow, sticky over content.

Layer tree of `Type=Message + primary, Style=Normal`. Nested components are shown by name; their internals live in their own blueprint.

- root — column
